# GPTShopExpert

> GPTShopExpert is a small, remote-first design & engineering studio that builds cinematic, high-performance websites. The team handles strategy, design, motion, and full-stack engineering end-to-end — no juniors, no account managers, no handoffs.

GPTShopExpert designs and engineers websites in-house, from first pixel to production. Typical projects ship on Next.js with a headless CMS, run at 60fps, and are measured against Core Web Vitals (CLS < 0.05, INP under 200ms) and WCAG 2.2 AA accessibility.

## Services

- [Signature websites](https://gptshopexpert.com/#services): Full strategy → design → build over 6–10 weeks. Discovery workshop, motion-first design in Figma & Framer, Next.js build on a headless CMS, performance & accessibility audit. From $18k.
- [Landing pages](https://gptshopexpert.com/#services): One conversion-focused page in 10 days. Copy & layout workshop, cinematic hero & scroll story, A/B-ready component system, analytics wiring. From $6k.
- [Growth & iteration retainer](https://gptshopexpert.com/#services): Ongoing design + engineering capacity. Dedicated designer & engineer, weekly async ships, quarterly performance & SEO, direct Slack channel. From $9k/mo.

## Capabilities

- UI/UX design (Figma, Framer, design systems)
- Frontend engineering (TypeScript, React, Next.js)
- Motion & 3D (Framer Motion, GSAP, Three.js, Spline)
- Backend & APIs (Node, edge functions, tRPC, REST, GraphQL, PostgreSQL)
- Brand & identity (strategy, logo, guidelines)
- CMS & headless (Sanity, Contentful, Payload)
- E-commerce (Shopify Hydrogen, Stripe, custom checkouts)
- Performance (Core Web Vitals, Lighthouse, edge)
- Accessibility (WCAG 2.2 AA, ARIA, audits)
- SEO & GEO (technical SEO, schema, llms.txt)
- Copy & content (headlines, microcopy, voice)
- Analytics & CRO (Plausible, PostHog, A/B testing)

## Process

1. Discover — interview, audit, and define the one metric that matters.
2. Design — motion-first mockups in Figma + Framer, clickable within a week.
3. Forge — TypeScript, Next.js, Framer Motion, with previews on every commit.
4. Launch — QA, Lighthouse, WCAG, and SEO checks before handoff.
